newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste buys Browing Ferris, Allied assets.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste buys Browing Ferris, Allied assets.

text.p: USA Waste Services Inc said Thursday it has acquired or will close shortly on definitive agreements to buy assets from Browning-Ferris Industries Inc.
USA Waste also purchased assets from Allied Waste Industries Inc, the company said.

From Browning-Ferris, USA Waste said it will acquire 12 collection and hauling operations, 2 landfills, 1 transfer station and 1 materials recovery facility in Arizona, California, Florida, Indiana, Louisiana, New York and Pennsylvania. The operations being acquired have total annual revenues of about $125 million, it said.

From Allied, the company said it acquired the Chiquita Canyon landfill in the Los Angeles market and all of Allied's collection operations in the Gaithersburg, Maryland/Washington D.C. market. It said these operations have total annualized revenues of about $34 million.
